displayName: [Spanner Observability] High API Error Rate - spanner-obs-mr

documentation.content:
### Spanner Instance Error Rate Alert

Spanner instance **spanner-obs-mr** in project **my-host-prj-472917** (VPC: **my-host-prj-shared-vpc**) is returning non-OK API responses (status != OK).

- **Instance**: spanner-obs-mr
- **Database**: finops-obs-db
- **Action**: Check Cloud Monitoring dashboard and application error logs for DEADLINE_EXCEEDED, ABORTED, INVALID_ARGUMENT, or UNAVAILABLE errors.

conditions.displayName: Spanner Non-OK API Request Rate > 0.05 req/s

conditionThreshold.filter: resource.type = "spanner_instance" AND resource.labels.instance_id = "spanner-obs-mr" AND metric.type = "spanner.googleapis.com/api/api_request_count" AND metric.labels.status != "OK"
